placements.title: system design decisions that shape how the pipeline operates
placements.frame: What architectural decisions are being settled here, and how do they constrain the system's operational behavior?
placements.why: Both segments describe architectural decisions about the async job contract — how remember dispatches work, how results are retrieved, and what guarantees the contract provides. This is system architecture: design decisions that shape operational behavior.

placements.title: the async job contract settled as mechanism, not argument
placements.frame: How does the async job contract get performed as a settled operational rule — stated as how the mechanism works rather than argued for?
placements.why: Both segments perform the async job contract as a settled decision: src-1 ratifies it with operational guarantees (immediate receipt, polling cursor, no blocking, no lost work), src-2 declares the dispatch-and-delivery mechanism (poll or piggyback). The theme is the contract being settled as operational mechanism rather than a position under debate.
